The author found a real gate defect: the gate's hardware view had no approval authority, so an R3 driver failed G6.CRASH (MHS.SAFETY.APPROVAL_REQUIRED). The gate is now its own approval authority for an R3 view over the fake backend only (MHS/changes/WAVE-B1.md); the reviewer re-ran the gate and recorded the pass. The author's notes as written at the time of the block follow. (After the registry rebuild the reviewer re-ran the gate and wrote its digest above.)

MINIMAL REPRO: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs.driver check MHS/drivers/labs/nion-software__nionswift-instrumentation-kit --backend fake

WHY SDK_BUG: the package drives nion.device_kit.InstrumentDevice:Instrument, whose voltage property reads and writes the EHT control (nion/device_kit/InstrumentDevice.py:155-161). EHT is the accelerating high voltage of the microscope, so MHS/spec/04-safety.md:69 makes the driver R3. G6 builds a hardware view for every declared hardware driver in mhs/driver/check.py:778-789 and constructs MHSServer(endpoint_id, [device], strict=True) without an approval_verifier; at R3 the server's session open then fails closed with MHS.SAFETY.APPROVAL_REQUIRED (mhs/server.py:7550-7560). The gate offers no test approval authority and the driver cannot inject one, so no honest R3 hardware driver can clear G6 or reach G9. This is the same limitation recorded for MHS/drivers/labs/silab-bonn__basil (blocked SDK_BUG). The rest of the gate passed: G1-G5, G7, G8. G9 did not run because G6 failed; the package-specific unittest cases in test_driver.py (all except the gate case) were run directly and pass.

PACKAGE: model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json authored_by kind model, model_id deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017, run_id wB1-033; reviewed_by null). No hardware backend was run and no hardware result is claimed. Reads: beam_voltage (EHT), defocus_m (C10), energy_offset_ev (ZLPoffset), beam_current_a (BeamCurrent). Writes: beam_voltage, defocus_m, energy_offset_ev, each Limit.operator_required because the clone names the controls but states no range; site-limits.example.json is an example overlay only. Safety: the upstream class has no stop, blank or shutdown method, so @estop and the safe-state action x-cap.nion-software.high_tension_off.v1 both write EHT as 0 through the value manager (the action satisfies SAFE-045). The C_Blank polarity is not documented, so the driver does not guess it. Fake: an in-memory GetVal/SetVal object mirroring the two upstream methods; starting values are placeholders. NOT COVERED: the 2D stage position (needs Geometry.FloatPoint from the external nion-utils package), the EELS/ronchigram camera arrays and acquisition controllers, and the MultiAcquire/focus workflows. NOT COVERED: an independent hardware e-stop; the clone documents none, so the safe-state action is the declared stop and a deployment still needs its own hardware protection.
